title: Shiftory agent-quality audited claim record
description: One auditor-classified material claim decomposed from a candidate explanation.json. The excerpt_sha256/start/end anchor is recomputed and checked against the actual candidate bytes by validation.py: this proves the claim points at real text in the real candidate. It does NOT prove the auditor noticed every proposition in the field -- that is asserted, not provable, via the sibling audit_coverage record (see candidate-evaluation-v1).

field.description: A json-pointer-style path into the candidate explanation, e.g. /items/2/statement or /summary.

verdict.description: supported_correct: the claim is true and well-grounded, including a claim that correctly and honestly describes a fact as ambiguous/unresolvable from the evidence. unsupported: not grounded in evidence. contradicted: actively asserts the wrong thing. ambiguous_unresolvable: the AUDITOR could not decide how to grade this specific claim at all (a rare fallback, distinct from a claim that itself correctly describes ambiguity, which is supported_correct). non_semantic: not a material behavioral assertion (e.g. a label or restatement).

materiality.description: Auditor-assigned impact of this claim if wrong, 1 (trivial) to 5 (central).

confidence_appropriate.description: Auditor judgment: does confidence_expressed match what the evidence actually supports for this specific claim?
